name: Galveston Ferry @ Galveston Ferry Landing
why: Galveston-Bolivar ferry landing. Surge and high water close the landing and back up evacuation traffic on the island.

name: Galveston Ferry @ HarborSide (N)
why: Harborside approach to the Galveston ferry landing. This low street floods before the ferry stops running.

name: Bolivar Ferry @ French Town Rd.
why: French Town Road on Bolivar Peninsula, the road into the ferry landing. Peninsula roads overwash in storms.

name: Bolivar Ferry @ 7th
why: 7th Street at the Bolivar ferry landing, inside the low peninsula street grid.

name: 45 GULF @ 61ST (W)
why: IH-45 on Galveston Island at 61st Street, the cross-island road between the seawall and the harbor.

name: 45 GULF @ CAUSEWAY (N)
why: North approach of the IH-45 Galveston Causeway, the low bay crossing onto the island. Catalog validimg is False; a GET of this still on 2026-11-03 still returned a JPEG.

name: 45 GULF @ TIKI ISLAND
why: Tiki Island on the West Bay side of the Galveston Causeway. The community roads sit just above the bay.

name: 45 Gulf @ Bay Area Blvd
why: IH-45 at Bay Area Boulevard, the Clear Lake coastal approach into southeast Harris County.

name: 45 Gulf @ Nasa Rd 1
why: IH-45 at NASA Road 1, the low Clear Lake corridor toward Galveston Bay.

name: NASA 1 @ SH-146
why: NASA Road 1 at SH-146 in Seabrook, a bayfront road on Galveston Bay.

name: SH-35 at Orange St
why: SH-35 at Orange Street in southeast Harris County, on the low coastal plain that drains toward Clear Creek.

name: 610 SOUTH LOOP @ OLD GALVESTON
why: Old Galveston Road at the IH-610 South Loop, a low southeast Houston corridor toward Sims Bayou.

name: SH288 @ MacGregor (Brays Bayou)
why: SH-288 at MacGregor Street where the freeway crosses Brays Bayou.

name: West Park @ Brays Bayou
why: Westpark Tollway at the Brays Bayou crossing.

name: FBTR @ Sims Bayou
why: Fort Bend Tollway at the Sims Bayou crossing.

name: W Sam Hou/BW8 @ Buffalo Bayou
why: Beltway 8 west where it crosses Buffalo Bayou.

name: 69 Eastex @ Greens Bayou
why: IH-69 Eastex at the Greens Bayou crossing.

name: US-90 @ Hunting Bayou
why: US-90 where it crosses Hunting Bayou in east Houston.

name: Buffalo Speedway@N Braeswood
why: Buffalo Speedway at North Braeswood, low ground beside Brays Bayou.

name: 610 WEST LOOP @ MEMORIAL
why: IH-610 West Loop at Memorial Drive, in the Buffalo Bayou floodplain along the Shepherd-Memorial corridor.
